subject.title: fix(mcp): stop ignored disabled servers from starting

question: Should OpenClaw accept that existing MCP configurations using the ineffective `disabled` key fail validation until doctor or update migration repairs supported layouts, while complex include layouts require manual correction?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and proof-positive, but changing previously accepted configuration into a fail-closed validation error is an intentional upgrade-compatibility decision that automation should not make.

options.title: Accept Guided Migration
options.body: Approve strict validation and the guarded doctor/update migration, accepting manual repair for ambiguous include ownership.

options.title: Stage With Warnings
options.body: Preserve parsing temporarily and warn operators before enforcing the canonical `enabled` field in a later release.

options.title: Require Broader Repair
options.body: Hold the validation change until complex include layouts also have a supported automatic migration path.

recommendation.title: Accept Guided Migration
recommendation.body: Approve strict validation and the guarded doctor/update migration, accepting manual repair for ambiguous include ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged MCP schema and node-hosted MCP ownership makes this the strongest available owner for the upgrade-contract decision.
